conflicts.subject: Portuguese naming collision: "Mata-Mata" used by 2 architecturally unrelated systems (Knowledge Phase 8, Part R, 2026-08-27)
conflicts.property: CLAIM-155 flags that this video's 'Mata-Mata' event is a preset WITHIN CustomArena (alongside sibling presets 'Sobrevivência' and 'Resta 1'), while the already-confirmed dedicated 'Kill All Event' documented in CLAIM-024/025/026 (EventKillAllSwitch, StartEventKillAllSyntax=PvPAll, JoinEventKillAllSyntax=PvPAll) is ALSO referred to as 'Mata-Mata Geral' in other vendor material. This was NOT flagged by scripts/knowledge-conflict-scan.mjs (Part R re-run, 187 claims) because the scanner matches on the literal entities array, and CustomArena/PvPAll never share an entity string -- it was found by manual cross-reading while building knowledge/vendor-sweep/beta-readiness/event-registry.json, which is exactly the semantic-alias class of issue mechanical entity-matching cannot catch.
conflicts.classification: NOT_A_CONFLICT (naming collision only, not a factual contradiction)
conflicts.reasoning: CLAIM-155 is explicit that these are 2 separate config files with separate command registrations -- CustomArena.txt's 'Mata-Mata' preset (no death limit, most kills by time end wins, one of several win-condition presets alongside Sobrevivência/Resta 1) versus PvPAll's own EventKillAllSwitch/JoinEventKillAllSyntax mechanism (score-based, +2/kill -1/death, top-3 reward). Both vendor materials happen to use the same Portuguese phrase for conceptually similar 'everyone fights, most kills wins' content, but they are not the same system, do not share config, and are independently enabled/disabled (both currently DISABLED, but via different switches: CustomArenaSwitch and EventKillAllSwitch).
conflicts.resolution: No factual correction needed -- both CLAIM-155 (CustomArena) and CLAIM-024/025/026 (PvPAll) remain accurate as written. Player-facing/support content (event-registry.json, Central de Eventos draft) has been explicitly annotated with a naming-collision caution on both entries so this alias is never conflated in Wiki drafts or support answers. Recorded here so the alias question does not need re-investigation in a future phase.
